remarks:
Tucked away on a wooded lot, Whispering Pines Chalet is the kind of place you escape to when you need a break from noise, crowds, or honestly… just from people. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath bungalow-style chalet blends modern style with cozy charm, offering a peaceful retreat that still keeps you close to everything Ellicottville has to offer.
Step inside to a stylishly updated interior with clean, contemporary finishes and warm, inviting spaces. Whether you're using it as a personal getaway or continuing its success as a short-term rental, the home strikes that perfect balance between comfort and style.
Upstairs, a wraparound deck delivers full-on treehouse vibes, ideal for morning coffee, evening wine, or just listening to the quiet of the woods. It’s the kind of setting that makes remote work feel less like work and more like a privilege.
The home is equipped for year-round enjoyment, featuring a cozy wood stove for chilly nights and a new water purification system for added peace of mind. And while it feels secluded, you're just 5 minutes from the shops and dining in the Village of Ellicottville, and only 10 minutes from the slopes and winter fun.
With four-season activities, festivals, and outdoor adventure at your doorstep, this property offers both a private sanctuary and a gateway to everything the area has to offer. Whether you're looking for an investment opportunity, a weekend escape, or simply a place to disappear for a while, Whispering Pines Chalet delivers. This great property is being sold fully furnished, so there is nothing to do but collect the keys at closing and enjoy!
